title: Mathematics
description: ICSE Class X Mathematics: one paper of 2.5 hours carrying 80 marks plus 20 marks internal assessment. Solutions may draw on more than one branch of the syllabus; logarithmic and trigonometric tables may be required.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Mathematics (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction and chapter weightage tables.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Areas: Algebra; Geometry; Mensuration; Trigonometry; Statistics; Probability.

sections.title: Mathematics
sections.paperLabel: ICSE Class X · Theory + Internal Assessment
sections.description: Algebra, Geometry, Mensuration, Trigonometry, Statistics and Probability.

chapters.title: GST (Goods and Services Tax)
chapters.blurb: Input tax, output tax, GST computation on transactions with discounts.

chapters.title: Banking
chapters.blurb: Recurring deposit accounts, maturity value, interest computation.

chapters.title: Shares and Dividends
chapters.blurb: Nominal value, market value, dividend, income and percentage return.

chapters.title: Linear Inequations
chapters.blurb: Properties of inequations, solution on the number line, representation of solution sets.

chapters.title: Quadratic Equations
chapters.blurb: Solution by factorisation and formula, nature of roots, word problems.

chapters.title: Ratio and Proportion
chapters.blurb: Componendo and dividendo, direct and inverse variations, proportion properties.

chapters.title: Factorisation of Polynomials
chapters.blurb: Remainder theorem, factor theorem, factorising polynomials.

chapters.title: Matrices
chapters.blurb: Order, addition, subtraction, multiplication of 2x2 matrices, identity and zero matrices.

chapters.title: Arithmetic Progression
chapters.blurb: nth term, sum of n terms, word problems on AP.

chapters.title: Coordinate Geometry: Reflection
chapters.blurb: Reflection of points in axes and lines, invariant points, section and mid-point formula, equation of a line.

chapters.title: Similarity
chapters.blurb: Similar triangles, areas of similar triangles, basic proportionality theorem, maps and models.

chapters.title: Loci
chapters.blurb: Locus of points satisfying given conditions, standard loci, constructions.

chapters.title: Circles
chapters.blurb: Chord properties, tangents, angle properties, cyclic quadrilaterals, tangent-chord results.

chapters.title: Constructions
chapters.blurb: Tangents to circles, circumscribing and inscribing circles in triangles.

chapters.title: Mensuration: Cylinder, Cone and Sphere
chapters.blurb: Surface area and volume of combined solids, conversions, melting and recasting problems.

chapters.title: Trigonometry: Identities and Heights & Distances
chapters.blurb: Complementary angles, trigonometric identities, angles of elevation and depression.

chapters.title: Statistics
chapters.blurb: Mean of grouped data, median, mode, histogram, ogive, quartiles.

chapters.title: Probability
chapters.blurb: Random experiments, events, simple problems on single and combined events.
